(ca)༄༅/ /gur gyi mgon po'i sku rten thun mong ma yin pa'i rab gnas zhag bdun mar grags pa'i cho ga dmigs rim bcas pa'i ngag 'don bstan srung dgyes

tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// gur gyi mgon po'i sku rten thun mong ma yin pa'i rab gnas zhag bdun mar grags pa'i cho ga dmigs rim bcas pa'i ngag 'don bstan srung dgyes pa'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang gi bka' lung rin chen cod paṇa che// ye shes 'jig rten srung ma kun gyi gtsug /ngal gsor bgyid pa bla ma'i tshogs btud cing*// thun mong min pa'i rab gnas ngag 'don 'dri// de'ang rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen po rdo rje nag po chen po'i gdams pa'i chos skor nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro rten gyi rnam gzhag las 'phros nas rten gsum thun mong ma yin pa ji ltar bzheng pa'i tshul rgyas pa ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir rab gnas thun mong ma yin pa'i cho ga dang dmigs pa rnams yid la nges pa'i phyir ngag 'don du bstar ba la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ gsar rnying gi rten bshams pa nas brtsams te/ bzang po drug ldan gyi rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa bzhin rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang rung zhig sngon du 'gro bar bya'o// de nas 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa zhag bdun du ye shes pa dngos su gzhug pa'i rab gnas bya ba la/ bris 'bur gang rung gi rten gyi mdun der/ gtor ma lnga tshar dang*/ mchod pa rgyas par bshams/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod me tog g.yab dar dang*/ rten gyi thugs ka'i thad kar gzungs thag btags pa bcas tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ nyi ma re la thun lnga lnga bcad dgos pa'i thun dang po la/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs nas/ kye rdo rje lam dus bzlas pa dang bcas pa'am/ lhag pa'i lha gang rung gi bsgom bzlas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar byas la/ yi dam gang yin gyi cho ga las 'byung ba ltar gtor ma byin rlabs nas/ yi dam gyi gtor 'bul gzhung ltar byas/

de nas mdun gyi rten bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes dpa' bo gcig pa'am/ lcam dral lha gnyis sam/ lha brgyad dam/ lha bcu gnyis la sogs pa rten gang yod kyi lha dang de dang der mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ kun la gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gsal gdab pa dang*/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa/ dam gzhag gtor ma 'bul ba/ phyi mchod nang mchod 'bul ba/ hūm̐ gi ye shes la sogs pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bstod pas bstod/ de nas bzlas dmigs kyi ngag 'don ni/ rten gang yin pa la gzungs thag btags pa nas bzung ste/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kar hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge bdun ma dang bcu gnyis ma shā sa na rnams dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar nag gis bskor bar bsams/ rang lhar gsal ba'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig sngags phreng yi ge brgya pa dang bcas pas bskor ba gsal btab nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od kha dog lnga ldan du 'phros sna bug g.yas nas thon/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la phog de rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga'i rnam par bsdus nas rten la thim pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam zhing brjod la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya zhes mtshan sngags btags pa'i yi ge brgya pa brgya rtsa bzla'o// yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer shar phyogs mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing khams su 'phros/ mi 'khrugs pa'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ de nyid kyi sku gang*/ de'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje rigs kyi mgon po mthing

rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug can/ ga'i rnam pa dpag tu med par gyur/ sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi rgyud sbyangs/ de'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rten la thim pas rten mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi mgon po mthing gar gyur par bsams zhing brjod la yig brgya sum brgya bzla'o// yang rten gyi mgon po las 'od 'phros/ snang srid thams cad la phog 'od sngon por zhu ba tshur 'dus te rten la thim/ rten 'od du zhu nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas yig brgya bzla zhing sems 'phro na sngar bzhin gsal btab la bzla'o// yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od dmar ser 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi dbu gtsug nas zhugs te sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ 'od des snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can la phog pas de rnams kyi nus pa thams cad 'od dmar por rang gi 'od la thim/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas lus ngag yid yon tan phrin las thams cad rgyas par byas/ 'od de phar 'phros mdun bskyed la thim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi nus pa thams cad rgyas par bsams la/ ā li kā li he ru ka'i yig brgya ye dharmā rnams brgya rtsa re bzla'o// de nas gzungs thag bsdus la/ rten la me tog 'thor zhing*/ rten 'di dag la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes lnga'i byin rlabs dang nus pa thams cad rten 'di nyid la ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes dang*/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs bkra shis gang rung zhig brjod do// de nas rten de nyid mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas su gsal ba la/

bskang gso bya ba ni/ bskang rdzas byin gyis brlabs nas/ chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos sogs kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs pa mdun gyi rten la bstim/ dam gzhag gtor 'bul dang*/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la/ mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba sogs sam/ yang na 'jam dbyangs sa los mdzad pa'i bskang gsar ltar bya ba'am/ ngor bskang ltar na/ bskang rdzas sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ he ru ka dpal sogs kyis bskang rdzas mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mnyes par bsam/ bstod pa gsar rnying gang rung gis bstod/ rdo rje'i glu thun gtor sogs nas rjes bkra shis kyi bar spyi ltar bya ste thun dang po'o// thun gnyis pa la gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs nas brtsams te bdag bskyed dang yi dam dang mdun gyi rten bskyed nas gtor 'bul mchod bstod kyi bar byas/ bzlas dmigs kyi ngag 'don sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas yig brgya bzla ba yan ni 'og ma kun la 'dra zhing*/ man chad kyi dmigs pa'i ngag 'don rnams kyang snga ma dang 'dra ba las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ shar dang mi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa'i tshab tu so sor kha bsgyur te/ de'ang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dmar po nub phyogs snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhing khams su 'phros/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ sku gang*/ de'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa thams cad sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo gsung ngam pad+ma'i rigs kyi mgon po dmar po'i rnam pa dpag tu med par gyur/ sems can 'dod chags can rnams kyi rgyud sbyangs nas/ de'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rten la thim pas rten pad+ma'i rigs kyi mgon po dmar po gzi 'od 'bar bar gyur par bsams la yig brgya bzla/ yang de las 'od 'phros/ pad+mas mtshan pa'i gri gug can/

'byung ba dang 'byung gyur gyi dngos po thams cad la phog de thams cad mgon po'i gsung gi rang bzhin sngags kyi yig 'bru rang sgra sgrogs pa sprin 'thibs pa ltar bsdus nas rten la thim pas gsung gi byin rlabs rgyas par gyur ces bsgyur la/ dbyangs gsal bzla ba sogs man chad bkra shis kyi bar thams cad 'dra bar bya ste thun gnyis pa'o// thun gsum pa la gzhan thams cad kyi ngag 'don gong dang 'dra ba las khyad par ni/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams dang rnam par snang mdzad kyi shangs bug dang me long ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam snang rigs kyi mgon po dkar po dang sems can gti mug can rnams kyi rgyud sbyangs zhes dang*/ rten rnam par snang mdzad kyi mgon po dkar po gzi 'od 'bar bar gyur par bsams la yig brgya bzla/ yang de las 'od 'phros pas gzugs snang yul gyi dngos po thams cad la phog sku'i mgon por gyur te/ rten la thim pas sku'i byin rlabs rgyas par bsams la dbyangs gsal sogs bzla ba yan chad 'dra bar bya ste thun gsum pa'o// thun bzhi pa la'ang gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba las lho phyogs rin 'byung gi zhing khams dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi shangs bug dang mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo rin chen rigs kyi mgon po ser po dang sems can nga rgyal dang ser sna can rnams kyi rgyud sbyangs zhes dang*/ rten rin chen 'byung ldan gyi mgon po ser po gzi 'od 'bar bar gyur par bsams la yig brgya bzla/ de las 'od 'phros brtan g.yo thams cad la phog de thams cad kyi bcud dang nus pa bsdus nas rten la thim pas yon tan mtha' yas pa nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur ces bsgyur la dbyangs gsal sogs man chad 'dra bar bya ste thun bzhi pa'o// thun lnga pa la'ang gzhan snga ma rnams dang 'dra ba las khyad par ni/ byang phyogs don grub kyi zhing khams dang don yod grub pa'i shang bug dang bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes kyi ngo bo las kyi rigs kyi mgon po ljang gu dang*/

sems can phrag don can rnams kyi rgyud sbyangs/ rten las kyi rigs kyi mgon po ljang gu gzi 'od 'bar bar gyur par bsams la yig brgya bzla'o// yang de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad la phog de thams cad kyi dge legs dang dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus te rten la thim pas phrin las thogs pa med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam zhing brjod la dbyangs gsal sogs bzla'o// de'i rjes su rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dril gsil dang g.yab dar tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa g.yob cing*/ sgrub grogs rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i rnga chen sogs rol mo'i bye brag gang 'byor dang*/ las kyi rdo rjes gu gul tshil chen sha chen spos sbyor gyi dud sprin dang*/ g.yab dar sngags can g.yob cing*/ rkang gling 'bud pa dang bcas te spyan 'dren par bsams la/ ngag tu bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi tshogs dang*/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka dang*/ yul nyer bzhi/ gnas so gnyis/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad/ 'phags yul rdo rje'i gdan la sogs pa'i gdan sa khyad par can rnams nas/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa la chos skyong ba'i mgon po dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod la dbyangs dang bcas te/ rdo rje 'chang chen bram ze mchog sred dang*// bde ba'i rdo rje shrad+dhā ka ra dang*// lo chen rin bzang bla ma brag steng pa// mal gyo blo gros grags pa gshegs su gsol// sa chen kun snying rje btsun bsod nams rtse// sngags 'chang mtshungs med rje btsun grags rgyal dang*// 'jam dbyangs sprul pa kun mkhyen paṇ+ḍi ta// chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa gshegs su gsol// mthu chen dam pa bdag chen bzang po dpal// mkhas btsun nam legs bla ma dam pa dang*// kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'jam dbyangs chen po dang*// bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dbang gshegs su gsol// kun spangs chen po tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bslab gsum rje// dbang phyug rab brtan khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba// mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gshegs su gsol// kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po zhwa lu pa// bsod nams mchog grub rje btsun ngag dbang lhun// kun dga' lhun grub byams pa bsod nams

dpal chos pa gang mos bsgyur/ bzang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun 'dus shing*// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ngo bo nyid// chos skyong kun gyis phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i// de 'dra gang yin bla ma gshegs su gsol// chos sku mkha' khyab pho brang lhun grub nas// thabs mkhas thugs rjes gang 'dul skur ston zhing*// bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gshegs su gsol// mgon po lha mo kun gshegs gdan la bzhugs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus tshod 'dir// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ni ngan na yang*// shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags bya ba'i phyir// gnas 'dir gshegs nas dngos grub ma lus stsol// zhes pa'i mthar/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥbadz+ra sa ma dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī badz+ra pā ṇā ye badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he badz+rā ya badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bighan ban+dha hūm̐/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ ma hā kā li de wi ye badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i sngags rnams drag rol gyi skabs su brjod cing*/ ye shes pa sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar byon nas rten la gnyis su med par thim par bsam zhing spyan 'dren gyi sngags bdun nam gsum sogs brjod pas yid ches par byed/ slar yang*/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs dpal mgon tshogs// lcam dral 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/

ma hā kā li de wi sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i tshigs bcad sngags bdun nas brgya tshun ting nge 'dzin brtan po'i ngang nas brjod/ mthar ma hā kā la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brgya stong du brjod la dbyer med du gyur par bsams/ de nas slob dpon gyis mgon po'i zhal mkhur gnyis la rak+ta'i thig le cung zad re dang*/ zhal gyi nang la'ang byug cing*/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon pos/ khams gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshigs pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrug pa/ sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod cing dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad nas zhal du gsol bar bsam mo// de'i rjes su bskang rdzas byin rlabs bskang gso rgyas pa bstod pa thun gtor 'bul ba tshogs 'khor rjes chog bkra shis kyi bar thams cad gong bzhin rgyas par bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ de ltar rab tu gnas pa legs par grub pa'i rten de la ye shes pa dngos su zhugs pa ni the tshom med pa'i phyir/ zhag bdun du mchod gtor rgya chen po 'bul bas mnga' gsol zhing*/ de nas kyang dam nyams dang snod min gyis mi mthong ba'i dben par ci 'byor ba'i mchod 'bul gyi bkur stir bgyid cing bzhugs su gsol na mchog dang thun mong gi gsol ba gang btab bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur 'gyur nges pa ni bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gi byin rlabs kyi gnad kyis so// bstan srung dbang po rten la rtag 'go zhing*// mngon 'dod phrin las thogs pa med 'grub pa'i// rab gnas byin rlabs drod ldan ngag 'don 'di// bgyis pa'i dge ba rgyal bstan rgyas phyir bsngo// zhes gur gyi mgon po'i sku rten thun mong ma yin pa'i rab gnas zhag bdun mar grags pa'i cho ga dmigs rim bcas pa'i ngag 'don bstan srung dgyes pa'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba'i 'di'ang*/

rang dang skal mnyam 'ga'i dran gso'i ched du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// thod pa sgrub pa'i ngag 'don dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gu ru ma hā kā lā ya na maḥ rdo rje nag po chen po'i shin tu zab pa'i shog dril las/ dngos grub 'byung gnas thod pa bsgrub par 'dod pas/ nal thod dam/ gri thod dum bu gcig pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la sbyong khrus la sogs pa byas la/ de'i nang du mtshal dang li khri dang rang byung gi rak+ta dang gi wang rnams gur gum gyi chur sbyangs pa snag tsha dang bsres nas/ thod pa'i nang gi dbus su na dang*/ dpral pa'i cha'i shar du go dang*/ lhor ku/ nub tu ha/ byang du da rnams yig 'bru khog che tsam dbu can mgo phyir bstan pa bri/ yi ge de dag gi khog pa'i nang du go rim de nyid kyis hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ āṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ ste bdud rtsi lnga'i sa bon dang*/ de rnams kyi khog par yang hūm̐ sogs bri ba ni ye shes lnga'i sa bon te yig 'bru rnams sum sbags kyi rnam pa can du bris pa'i mthar/ dpral ba nas brtsams te g.yon skor du ā li bcu drug gis 'khor ba dang*/ de'i phyir g.yas skor du kā li so bzhis 'khor bar bris/ de gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i nang du sku'i rtags sman sna tshogs/ gsung gi rtags dri sna tshogs/ thugs kyi rtags snying po sna tshogs/ yon tan gyi rtags rin po che sna tshogs/ mi 'gyur bde chen mtshon pa'i rtags su sha sna tshogs/ longs spyod kyi rtags su dar sna tshogs/ dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i rtags su khrag dang chang blugs pas bkang nas/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang bcas te bzhag la/ bdag bskyed dang yi dam gtor 'bul gzhung ltar byas/ thod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mgon po 'khor bcas mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/

khyad par phyag g.yon na thod pa stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa srid pa gsum gyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis gang ba bsnams pa sgrub po yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la dngos grub rnam pa gnyis thogs pa med par gnang ba'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ de dag gi dpral bar oṃ zhes sogs kyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje nag po chen po sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa sku mdog mthing nag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa dngos grub sna tshogs pa'i bcud kyis gang ba bsnams pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ dam gzhag mchod gtor 'bul ba rnams spyi ltar grub nas/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad ā li kā li dang snying po la sogs pa gsung yig 'bru'i rnam par spyan drangs te rten la thim par bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad rdo rje dang gri gug la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te rten la bstim pa'i dmigs pa bya zhing*/ yi dam gyi snying pos 'go drangs la/ yi ge bdun ma dang shā sa na ci rigs par bzlas la mjug tu/ oṃ badz+ra ka pā la gra ha sid+dhi dzñā na sid+dhī hūm̐ zhes pa mang du bzlas/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang thod pa las 'od zer 'phros pas srid pa gsum gyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ lha mi'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad dang*/

snod kyi 'jig rten gyi dge legs dang bkra shis thams cad bdud rtsi kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par bsdus nas phyag g.yon gyi thod par thim/ thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi kha nas lud pas bdag cag yon mchod rnams la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsol bar bsams la rgyas pa na rtags ma byung bar ram ji ltar rigs par bsgrub bo// mthar 'dod don gsol la/ mgon po 'od du zhu nas thod pa'i rnam par gyur par bsams nas tshogs 'khor brtan bzhugs dang bkra shis sogs gong bzhin byas la/ thod pa de nang rin po che dang 'bru sna tshogs kyis bkang la dar sna tshogs kyis dril te/ mis mi mthong bar bzhugs su gsol na mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad sprin bzhin du 'du zhing dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur nges pa ni gdams pa'i zab khyad nyid kyis so// zhes gur gyi mgon po'i thod sgrub kyi ngag 'don dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ched du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
